toegepas.voor: Regmaak was stadig en jy kon
toegepas.na: Regmaak was stadig, en jy kon
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: two clauses each with their own subject and verb (Regmaak was; jy kon) take a comma before en.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb (Regmaak was; jy kon).
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 comma before en is required here and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: Elke sleutel met 'n letter op is aan 'n dun metaalstrokie vas.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'met 'n letter daarop' and 'sit ... vas' are the natural written forms; 'is ... vas' with a stranded 'op' reads colloquial; same word count.
toegepas.fout: The stranded 'op' and 'is ... vas' read colloquial and stiff in study text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'met 'n letter daarop sit ... vas' is the natural written form, same word count and same meaning (the key is attached to the strip).

toegepas.voor: Meer as een masjien wat letters kon druk, het in daardie tyd bestaan.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Moving the time phrase to the front removes the heavy subject before 'het' and reads more naturally; same words, same meaning.
toegepas.fout: A heavy subject with a relative clause before 'het' reads wooden and English-shaped.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting the time phrase reads naturally with the same words and the same claim (more than one letter-printing machine existed then).
